name: Ring of Feral Rage
body:
Aura faint enchantment; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of animal friendship. However, if an animal fails its Will save when the wearer uses the charm animal ability, the animal becomes enraged and immediately attacks the wearer. The animal gains a +2 bonus to attack and damage against the wearer and attacks the wearer until one of them is slain.

Casting remove curse upon the ring, followed by calm emotions, allows the wearer to remove it, though the enchantment remains intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of animal friendship

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
